messages.content: 進行兩個獨立樣本的假設檢定，樣本1的分數為[22,33,42,12,34]，樣本2的分數為[23,45,44,14,38]，顯著性水平為0.05。

function.name: hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind
function.description: Conducts a hypothesis test for two independent samples. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample1.description: First set of observations (array of numbers).

sample2.description: Second set of observations (array of numbers).

significance_level.description: Significance level of the test (default: 0.05) This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform an independent samples t-test. We have sample1: [22,33,42,12,34], sample2: [23,45,44,14,38]. Significance level 0.05. We should compute means, variances, pooled variance or Welch's? The function likely does Welch's t-test? Let's assume equal variances? But typical t-test uses Welch's if not equal. We'll compute both? Provide results: t-statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value. Then conclusion: fail to reject null? Let's compute.

Compute sample1 mean: sum=22+33+42+12+34=143; n1=5; mean1=28.6. Sample2 sum=23+45+44+14+38=164; mean2=32.8. Differences: mean difference = -4.2.

Compute sample variances: For sample1: deviations: 22-28.6=-6.6, squared=43.56; 33-28.6=4.4, sq=19.36; 42-28.6=13.4, sq=179.56; 12-28.6=-16.6, sq=275.56; 34-28.6=5.4, sq=29.16. Sum squares=527.2. Sample variance s1^2 = sum/(n1-1)=527.2/4=131.8. s1= sqrt(131.8)=11.49.

Sample2: deviations: 23-32.8=-9.8, sq=96.04; 45-32.8=12.2, sq=148.84; 44-32.8=11.2, sq=125.44; 14-32.8=-18.8, sq=353.44; 38-32.8=5.2, sq=27.04. Sum squares=650.8. s2^2=650.8/4=162.7. s2=12.77.

Pooled variance: sp^2 = ((n1-1)s1^2 + (n2-1)s2^2)/(n1+n2-2) = (4*131.8 + 4*162.7)/8 = (527.2+650.8)/8=1178/8=147.25. sp=12.136.

Standard error of difference: SE = sp * sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2) = 12.136 * sqrt(1/5+1/5)=12.136*sqrt(0.4)=12.136*0.63246=7.67.

t = (mean1-mean2)/SE = (-4.2)/7.67 = -0.5479.

Degrees of freedom df = n1+n2-2=8.

Two-tailed p-value: For t= -0.548 with df=8. Use t distribution. Rough approximate: t critical at alpha=0.05 two-tailed: t_crit ~ ±2.306. Our |t|=0.548 < 2.306, so fail to reject. p-value > 0.05. Let's approximate p-value: For df=8, t=0.55 gives p ~ 0.59? Actually t=0.55 yields p ~ 0.59. So p ~ 0.59.

Thus we conclude fail to reject null hypothesis that means equal.

Alternatively use Welch's t-test: df = (s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2)^2 / ((s1^2/n1)^2/(n1-1)+(s2^2/n2)^2/(n2-1)). Compute numerator: s1^2/n1 = 131.8/5=26.36; s2^2/n2=162.7/5=32.54. Sum=58.90. Square=3469.21. Denominator: (26.36^2)/(4)+ (32.54^2)/(4) = (694.5)/4 + (1059.5)/4 =173.63+264.88=438.51. df=3469.21/438.51=7.92 ~7.9. t same as above but df slightly different. p-value similar ~0.59.

Thus answer: t ≈ -0.55, df≈8, p≈0.59 > 0.05, fail to reject H0.
